english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for having an effect on or swaying someone or something.
This is the all-purpose verb for influencing or changing something, and it is also the natural everyday choice when an illness harms an organ.
This is the all-purpose choice for having a negative effect on something.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for damaging someone's prospects or quality of life.

examples.english: This film can influence how I see family.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲影響咗我對家庭嘅睇法。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 jing2 hoeng2 zo2 ngo5 deoi3 gaa1 ting4 ge3 tai2 faat3

examples.english: This will affect whether I can get to work tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 呢件事會影響我聽日返工。
examples.jyutping: nei1 gin6 si6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 ngo5 ting1 jat6 faan1 gung1

examples.english: Using a phone for long periods can impair your eyesight.
examples.traditional: 長時間用手機會影響視力。
examples.jyutping: coeng4 si4 gaan1 jung6 sau2 gei1 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 si6 lik6

examples.english: The company's sudden move can blight our family's livelihood.
examples.traditional: 公司突然搬走，真係可以影響我哋一家嘅生計。
examples.jyutping: gung1 si1 dat6 jin4 bun1 zau2 zan1 hai6 ho2 ji5 jing2 hoeng2 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 ge3 sang1 gai3
